title: improvement-report-data
description: Schema version 1.1. Written by the CLI orchestrator at run time under --self-improve. Accumulates user decisions and shipped prompt via C# server write-back. Intended for staging and commit alongside implementation changes.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must be '1.1' for this revision.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of initial file generation by the CLI orchestrator.

origin.description: Provenance block written by the orchestrator at generation time. Disambiguates user-level vs repo-level skill installs and records the on-disk skill path so shipped prompts are self-contained.

skill_scope.description: 'repo' takes precedence when both scopes exist at the same skill_id.

skill_path.description: Absolute on-disk path to the skill directory at generation time.

repo_root.description: Absolute path to the git repository root from which the run was invoked.

run_id.description: Run identifier (format: run-YYYYMMDD-HHMM). Matches the run directory name.

findings.description: Ordered improvement findings. Written once at generation time and immutable thereafter. Cross-run dedup is applied CLI-side before this array is written; each entry represents one collapsed suggestion_key.

decisions.description: User decisions keyed by finding id. Empty object at generation time. Written by the C# server in response to user gestures (POST /api/dismissals, POST /api/ship-prompt). Presence of any key here is a CLI staging readiness signal.

shipped_prompt.description: Written by the C# server when POST /api/ship-prompt completes. null at generation time. Presence of this field is a CLI staging readiness signal.

readable.description: Browser-assembled readable prompt including origin preamble.

transformed.description: Server-transformed LLM-optimised output from the compression middleware chain.

shipped_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the prompt was shipped.

finding.description: One improvement finding after CLI-side cross-run dedup fold.

id.description: Stable finding identifier within this run (e.g. 'f-001'). Used as key in the decisions map.

suggestion_key.description: Deterministic cross-run identity key. Derived from normalized intent + target surface + proposed change shape; volatile wording and scores excluded. See docs/self-improve-generation.md for derivation rules.

specialist.description: Lane name of the specialist that surfaced this finding (e.g. 'blazor-component-architect').

title.description: Short human-readable title. Latest-run value wins on dedup fold.

summary.description: 1-3 sentence explanation of the weakness or gap. Latest-run value wins on dedup fold.

category.description: Functional category. Findings are grouped by category in the HTML report.

severity.description: Pre-derived severity. Max across all occurrences on dedup fold. Derivation is upstream (ticket-14 scope); this schema does not define the algorithm.

expected_impact.description: 1-2 sentence description of the expected improvement if the prompt fragment is adopted. Latest-run value wins on dedup fold.

prompt_fragment.description: Concrete prompt text the user can queue and ship. Latest-run value wins on dedup fold.

evidence.description: Evidence union across all dedup-folded occurrences. Each item is annotated with its run context.

recurrence_count.description: Number of distinct runs in which this suggestion_key appeared. 1 for first-seen findings. Present when dedup history is available.

first_seen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the earliest run in which this suggestion_key appeared.

last_seen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent run in which this suggestion_key appeared.

ranking_score.description: Composite ranking score: base_severity_weight + recurrence_boost + history_weight. Used to order findings within their severity group. Visible in HTML for explainability.

evidence_item.description: Pointer to a self_diagnosis entry in a specialist report, optionally annotated with run context for dedup-folded evidence unions.

specialist.description: Lane name of the specialist that emitted the evidence.

issue_index.description: Zero-based index into the specialist's self_diagnosis.issues array.

run_id.description: Run ID of the occurrence that produced this evidence. Populated for dedup-folded records; omitted for single-run findings.

run_timestamp.description: generated_at timestamp of the run that produced this evidence. Populated for dedup-folded records.

decision.description: User decision record written by the C# server.

action.description: 'queued': finding was included in shipped prompt. 'dismissed': user dismissed. 'skipped': user passed over without action.

dismissed_reason.description: Optional free-text reason provided by the user on dismissal.

decided_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the decision was recorded.
